title: The first sip

prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with plain collar. Include only characters named in the scene, never add ROB when it says no robot. Draw specifically the described action and viewpoint with natural interaction, not stock standing front view. Coherent scene, 4-6 main elements, big shapes and broad outlines. Fill most of portrait 2:3 page while keeping white margin. SCENE: Bird bends to sip from the shallow dish; low eye-level view with ROB and Puppy watching in soft simple outlines behind.
